scene: Sophia shows you another studio’s quote
try: Open Quote X-Ray on Sophia’s quote
how:
1. Open Sophia Wong › "Quotes" tab
2. Hover the quote’s row and click "More actions" (⋮)
3. Choose "Compare with another quote"
expect: Quote X-Ray opens for Sophia Wong: the lead is fixed and "… · Tampines 4-room renovation" is already chosen, "Confirmed · 9 lines".

scene: Sophia shows you another studio’s quote
how:
1. Drop uat-files/rival-quote-urban-nest.xlsx on "The other studio’s quote" (or click it to browse)
2. Type "Urban Nest Interiors" in "Their studio’s name (optional)"
expect: Under the file it says "10 lines read · S$13,470.00" at once; the hint clears and "Compare" can be clicked.
in10: Different from 1.0: spreadsheets are read as you pick them

scene: Sophia shows you another studio’s quote
how:
1. Click "Compare"
2. Watch the progress card until the result opens
expect: "Comparing the two quotes…" ticks through four steps, then "Sophia Wong · vs Urban Nest Interiors" opens with the date and items compared.

how:
1. Read the sentence under the caption
2. Read the three figures
3. Read the note under them
4. Hover the quote’s name in the caption — it links to your quote
expect: About S$ 17.7K yours, S$ 13.5K theirs, "Real difference" S$ 3.8K "ours more, like-for-like"; the note says both sides are before discounts and GST.
in10: Different from 1.0: both sides compared on line totals, before GST

how:
1. Scroll to "Item by item"
2. Find "Lighting points", "Hacking of kitchen floor and wall tiles" and "Haulage and disposal of debris"
expect: Lighting shows both quantities (18 vs 16 points); hacking is "Matched" despite different words; haulage reads "No price given".
in10: Different from 1.0: rates are compared and both quantities shown

try: Tell X-Ray two lines are not the same item
how:
1. Hover the "Quartz countertop" row and click "More actions" (⋮)
2. Choose "Not the same item"
expect: "Marked as not the same item" (with Undo); the row splits into "Only in yours" and "Only in theirs" and the figures change.
in10: Different from 1.0: you can correct a match on the result

try: Pair the two countertops again by hand
how:
1. On the "Quartz countertop" row open "More actions" (⋮) › "Same item as…"
2. Pick "Laminate countertop" in the list
3. Click "Pair"
expect: The row is matched again with the status "Paired by you"; the foot of the page reads "Corrected by Dane on …".
in10: Different from 1.0: you can correct a match on the result

how:
1. Read the three points under "Say this"
2. On the wardrobe point, click "Say it as a question"
3. Read "Key points you can use"
expect: Points: wardrobe priced well below ours, a laminate worktop question, missing waterproofing. Key points: Nippon Paint "Your advantage", KDK "Impact: high", Dulux checked.
in10: Different from 1.0: brand notes are curated, not searched online

try: Send Sophia the summary on WhatsApp (without really sending)
how:
1. Click "Send to client"
2. Check the message never names Urban Nest Interiors, and change a word
3. Click "Open WhatsApp" — a WhatsApp tab opens: close it, do not send
4. Click "Send to client" again
expect: The wardrobe point goes as your question; the header shows "Sent …"; the dialog reopens on your edited text, with "Reset to draft".
in10: Different from 1.0: what you sent is kept and shown

scene: Compare two files without a lead
try: Compare two files with no lead attached
how:
1. Click "Tools" › "Quote X-Ray", then "Upload two quotes"
2. Drop uat-files/kitchen-moodboard.jpg on "The other studio’s quote" and read the message
3. Drop uat-files/sophia-items-to-paste.xlsx on "Your quote" and uat-files/cove-interior-quotation.pdf on "The other studio’s quote"
4. Click "Compare"
expect: The photo is refused ("We couldn’t read this one…"); the PDF reads "20 lines read from Cove Interior’s quote"; the result opens.

scene: Compare two files without a lead
how:
1. On its result click "More options" (⋮) › "Delete"
2. Click "Delete" in "Delete this comparison?"
expect: It warns this can’t be undone; you land back on Quote X-Ray and it is gone from "Recent comparisons".
in10: Different from 1.0: only its maker, an Owner or an Admin deletes

try: Rerun a reading whose quote has changed since
how:
1. On Quote X-Ray, find Sophia’s reading under "Recent comparisons" (it says "Sent …")
2. Open "Olivia Martinez · vs Flo Design"
3. Click "Run again" in the banner
expect: A banner says the quote has changed since this comparison; "Run again" opens a fresh reading: "Run again — the earlier comparison is kept".
in10: Different from 1.0: it tells you when your quote changed

try: Mark a lost lead with the competitor from X-Ray
how:
1. Open Vivien Lee from the Leads list
2. Click "Stage: Quote Sent" › "Lost"
3. Keep the reason "Went with another firm" and read "Competitor (optional)"
4. Click "Save & Move"
expect: Competitor already reads "Flo Design", noted "From the Quote X-Ray of …"; after saving, "Moved to Lost" and Vivien Lee shows Lost.
in10: Different from 1.0: the competitor comes from the lead’s X-Ray
